title: Remote connector command (relay)
description: The remote command relay (docs/API.md §connector:relay). A web member ENQUEUES a command for the app owner's paired FormLogic Desktop runtime, which CLAIMS it (pending→claimed exactly-once) and COMPLETES it (claimed→done|failed). Canonical copy: formlogic-app/docs/contracts/.

enqueueRequest.title: Enqueue request
enqueueRequest.description: Body of POST /api/app/{slug}/connector-commands (session; app member AND connector.<connectorId>.<command> grant). Reserve-first on idempotencyKey.

payload.description: Command payload (≤ 16 KiB encoded). Shape is connector/command specific.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional dedupe key; a duplicate returns the existing command. Absent → a fresh random key (no dedupe).

claimRequest.title: Claim request
claimRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/connector-commands/{id}/claim (scope connector:relay). Atomic pending→claimed; 409 if already claimed or expired.

instanceId.description: Optional claimer instance id (the desktop install id), stored as claimedBy.

completeRequest.title: Complete request
completeRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/connector-commands/{id}/complete (scope connector:relay). claimed→done|failed; 409 if not in the claimed state.

result.description: The connector's response (≤ 64 KiB encoded). Present on done.

error.description: Failure detail (≤ 64 KiB encoded). Present on failed.

command.title: Command record
command.description: A desktop_commands row (DesktopCommandService::format) as returned by the enqueue/get/claim/complete endpoints.
